source: Apache Commons Lang GitHub Pull Request and source history
technology: Apache Commons Lang / Java / random character generation and range bounds
error_description: RandomStringUtils.nextGraph and nextPrint fail to generate the tilde character even though the documented POSIX character sets include that endpoint.
i_base: RandomStringUtils.nextGraph and nextPrint delegate to a shared random-generation method.
The shared method interprets its end parameter as exclusive.
The documented graph range ends at 0x7E and the documented print range also ends at 0x7E.
The sibling nextAscii method passes 127 to include the character at 0x7E.
The fix changes the end argument to 127 and adds boundary tests that require tilde to appear.

ccdg.details: The method passes a start and exclusive end bound.
The print range uses the same exclusive-end convention.
An end value of 126 excludes code point 126 itself.
The endpoint must be reachable while no out-of-range character is generated.

ground_truth.entity: documented tilde endpoint at code point 0x7E
ground_truth.operation: pass the upper bound to the shared random generation method

software_twin_snapshot.observed_failure_signal: The documented tilde endpoint was not generated within the regression test's bounded attempts on the pinned pre-fix revision.
